name: react
stack_notes: Avoid flaky waits; use condition-based assertions
preferred_patterns: Complex UI flows use useReducer (state machine style) rather than scattered useState
Async UI tests use findBy*/waitFor with explicit timeouts
Use MSW for network mocking if present
testing_rules: Test user-visible behavior, not implementation details
No real network calls in unit/component tests
reviewer_quality_gates: UI state transitions should be explicit for multi-step flows
